correctness.rationale: Exact Hermite–Laguerre identity with alpha=±1/2 reduces roots to a pair of consecutive Laguerre polynomials. Their interlacing guarantees m real simple t-roots. A positive-residue partial fraction for the monic ratio proves the unique negative t-root appears exactly when b>2(m+alpha). Its derivative starts at 2(m+alpha)/(alpha+1), decreases toward 2, and its affine asymptotic yields both optimal global bounds, strict convexity of the squared escape trajectory for degree at least four, and both asymptotics. Boundary multiplicities follow from t=x²/2. CHECK.py from the actual package passed 195 supplementary symbolic/numeric assertions.
